C368241.observed: Through the screen: initials > Edit Profile (/profile), clicked the photo and picked the red photo, then reloaded. The top-bar avatar showed the red photo (picture C368241-avatar-before). Then Edit Profile again and the blue photo was picked; the page sent one upload of the avatar. After going back and reloading the page, the top-bar avatar showed the BLUE photo, not the old red one (picture C368241-avatar-after). The avatar image loaded properly both times (256 px wide, answered 200), so the earlier broken-image impression was a capture taken before the image arrived, not a fault.
